data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** $(git rev-parse HEAD)
* **Context Scope:** plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py _SYSTEM_PROMPT
* **Active Configs:** provider=anthropic, model=claude-sonnet-4-6 (standard tier default)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

The CI llm-review job should produce findings with severity values drawn from the DSO reviewer schema vocabulary: "critical", "important", "minor". Downstream processing and the reviewer-findings.json schema depend on these exact values.

#### Actual Behavior

In PR #56 CI run (job 74669479348), claude-sonnet-4-6 produced findings with severity "medium" and "low" — neither of which are valid DSO severity values. The _SYSTEM_PROMPT in dispatch.py says 'severity (string)' without constraining valid values. Models use their own training-derived vocabulary instead.

Raw CI output excerpt:
  "severity": "medium" (dispatch.py:71-72)
  "severity": "low" (runner.py:88-92)

### 5. Skills and Workflows

Affected: plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py _SYSTEM_PROMPT (line ~22-28)
data.title: [dispatch.py _SYSTEM_PROMPT]: severity field missing valid values -> model uses 'medium'/'low' instead of 'important'/'minor'/'critical'
